project.name: VexelRay GUI :: Typeset
project.description: Structured, non-editable rich text: seven composition primitives, type sizes declared as ratios and tone-mapped into a legible range per block, and a projection onto floating nodes. It complements the flex layout engine rather than extending it — a typeset block is an atom with an intrinsic size, and its interior is its own composition world. It holds no opinion about markup: the app builds the IR. See docs/typeset.md.
